neighbours.label: research-reporting prose at the point where a group or condition has just been named and its measured outcome is about to be reported ('posts with images receive ...', 'with a complete treatment, I saw ...')
fire: The field trials ran for three seasons across the county. "On my plots, when I used seed with the full fungicide coating, I saw a remarkable gain in yield," one grower told us.
Automation brought lower costs and faster service. Sales per employee rose more than 3 percent a year in the wholesale sector after 2001.
Exercise seems to protect the brain. The study found that those with the most demanding routines showed the smallest loss of memory over ten years.
Pictures clearly matter on social media: tweets with photos get about 35% more replies than tweets without them.
The survey compared two groups of stores. In shops where staff greeted customers at the door, average spending was nearly 20 percent higher.
Sleep had a measurable effect. Among pupils who went to bed before ten, test scores improved by almost a full grade after one term.
The results were clear by harvest. Fields with drip irrigation produced roughly 30% more grain than fields watered by hand.
Wearables are everywhere now. In offices today, employees with a step counter walk on average 2,000 more steps than those without one.
quiet: The field trials ran for three seasons across the county. "On my plots, I keep the seed in a dry shed and I check the bags every week," one grower told us.
Automation brought new machines and new uniforms. The wholesale sector moved its offices to the edge of town after 2001.
Exercise seems to be popular here. The club is open to those who enjoy demanding routines and meets in the hall every Tuesday.
Pictures are easy to add on social media: tap the camera icon, choose a photo and write a caption.
The survey visited two groups of stores. In some shops the staff wore blue aprons and stood near the door.
Bedtime was a matter of routine. Pupils brushed their teeth, read a chapter and switched off the light before ten.
The work was finished by harvest. Fields near the river belong to the co-operative and are fenced with wire.
Wearables are everywhere now. In offices today, employees charge them at their desks and compare the colours of the straps.

notes: Card: no single token (',', ' with', ' today', ' in', ' where', ' after'); top examples name a group or condition right before a quantified result, and the output promotes ' amount', ' incidence'. One probe round did NOT reproduce it (all 8 probes under 0.09, including close paraphrases of the top examples), so the trigger probably needs more context than a sentence. Registered as the card's best reading with longer passages; I expect it to fail.
